translations.web: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”
translations.bsb: Now you have gone off because you long for your father’s house. But why have you stolen my gods?”
translations.kjv: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
translations.asv: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
